DATR.description: Diagnostic Load Test Rating (DATR). Fields are driven by POSITION (which member end is measured) and LTM_TYPE (whether the load-test measurement is auto-calculated from strains or entered directly as an adjustment factor).

POSITION.description: Position type: 0=I, 1=J, 2=I & J. Selects which member end(s) the strain measurement applies to.

LTM_TYPE.description: Load Test Measurement type: 0=Auto Calculation (uses STRAIN_I/STRAIN_J and KB), 1=User Input (uses K).

STRAIN_I.description: [LTM_TYPE=0 and POSITION=0 or 2] Strain at I-End. Validated (must be >= 0) only for Auto Calculation when POSITION is 0 (I) or 2 (I & J).

STRAIN_J.description: [LTM_TYPE=0 and POSITION=1 or 2] Strain at J-End. Validated (must be >= 0) only for Auto Calculation when POSITION is 1 (J) or 2 (I & J).

KB.description: [LTM_TYPE=0] Load Test Measurement Benefit Factor. Validated (must be > 0) only for Auto Calculation.

K.description: [LTM_TYPE=1] Adjustment Factor. Validated (must be > 0) only for User Input.
